title: Prepare the Iris classification split
description: You load features and labels, standardize them, and inspect the split sizes.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You load Iris measurements as floats and labels as integers. Feature and class names remain available for later displays.
You standardize the full X matrix and retain its mean and scale. This call happens before the train-test split.

steps.question: Does train_test_split receive raw X or X_std?
steps.answer: It receives X_std and y, with test_size=0.3 and rng. Both returned feature splits therefore come from the already standardized matrix.

steps.description: You print the training and test shapes. The recorded class names are setosa, versicolor, and virginica.
